issues.issue: The General Fund schedule prints one Taxes line, and no page prints its own property/motor vehicle breakdown. The split is deduced: Statement of Activities property + motor vehicle (p2) equal it exactly, and the nonmajor taxes 743,357 are printed per fund as Visitors (lodging) 717,516 and 911 (other) 25,841 (pp6-9). It is marked computed and the arithmetic holds, but the rule only allows splits whose breakdown the report prints for that line, so a person should confirm it. Same for detail[1].
